fields.label: Flexible Sections
fields.name: flex_sections
fields.instructions: Add, reorder, and configure sections for this page.

sub_fields.label: Title
sub_fields.name: title
sub_fields.instructions: Choose title

sub_fields.label: Title Tag
sub_fields.name: title_tag
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the semantic tag for the title.

sub_fields.label: Subtitle Tag
sub_fields.name: subtitle_tag
sub_fields.instructions: Choose the semantic tag for the subtitle.

sub_fields.label: Height Desktop
sub_fields.name: min_height_desktop
sub_fields.instructions: Value in px, e.g. 560

sub_fields.label: Height Mobile
sub_fields.name: min_height_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Value in px, e.g. 360

sub_fields.label: Background Overlay Gradient
sub_fields.name: background_overlay_gradient
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. If filled, overrides the Background Overlay Color. Paste a full CSS gradient value, e.g. linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.6) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%).

sub_fields.label: Reverse Layout
sub_fields.name: reverse_layout
sub_fields.instructions: Show image on the left and content on the right (desktop only). Mobile order stays the same.

sub_fields.label: Right Side Image
sub_fields.name: right_image
sub_fields.instructions: Shown next to the content when Content Width is 50% or 75%.

sub_fields.label: Content Font Color
sub_fields.name: font_color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default theme style.

sub_fields.label: Button 1
sub_fields.name: button_1
sub_fields.instructions: Set the button label, URL and target.

sub_fields.label: Button 2
sub_fields.name: button_2
sub_fields.instructions: Set the button label, URL and target.

sub_fields.label: Image on Right Side
sub_fields.name: image_position
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to place the image on the right (text on the left). Leave off for image on the left.

sub_fields.label: Image Outside Container
sub_fields.name: image_no_container
sub_fields.instructions: Enable to break the image out of the container, on whichever side it is placed.

sub_fields.label: Background Color
sub_fields.name: background_color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default background color.

sub_fields.label: Section Padding Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: padding_desktop
sub_fields.instructions: Top/bottom padding on desktop. Leave empty to use the default (20px).

sub_fields.label: Section Padding Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: padding_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Top/bottom padding on mobile. Leave empty to use the default (20px).

sub_fields.label: Content Row Gap Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: row_gap_desktop
sub_fields.instructions: Gap between title/text/buttons on desktop. Leave empty to keep the current style default (16px).

sub_fields.label: Content Row Gap Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: row_gap_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Gap between title/text/buttons on mobile. Leave empty to keep the current style default (8px).

sub_fields.label: Custom CSS Class
sub_fields.name: custom_class
sub_fields.instructions: Added to the section's outer wrapper. Use this to target the section with your own custom CSS. Separate multiple classes with a space.

sub_fields.label: Image Border Radius (px)
sub_fields.name: image_border_radius
sub_fields.instructions: e.g. 10 for a 10px border radius. Leave empty for square corners.

sub_fields.label: Image Height Desktop (px)
sub_fields.name: image_height_desktop
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default (400px).

sub_fields.label: Image Height Mobile (px)
sub_fields.name: image_height_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default (300px).

sub_fields.label: Image Fit
sub_fields.name: image_fit
sub_fields.instructions: How the image fills its box.

sub_fields.label: Title 1 Color
sub_fields.name: titleh1_color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default theme style.

sub_fields.label: Title 2 Color
sub_fields.name: titleh2_color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default theme style.

sub_fields.label: Title 3 Color
sub_fields.name: titleh3_color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default theme style.

sub_fields.name: font_color
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to use the default theme style.

sub_fields.name: margin_bottom_mobile
sub_fields.instructions: Value in px, e.g. 16

sub_fields.label: Items
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: Add counter boxes. Each item animates from 0 to the target number.
